defects: The empty whole-route exception did not explicitly distinguish empty tokens in a nonempty route.

rationale: Retain all three correct boards and explicitly preserve literal hyphen tokens. Empty tokens can have a mapped name; only an entirely empty route returns no tokens. Target linear in route UTF-16 length includes splitting/case conversion/key hashing under average Map access, not a scan of all airports.

objective: Sum adjacent Euclidean distances without consuming input, accepting ordinary floating-point rounding differences.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: Typed records, adjacent traversal and Number arithmetic remain current foundations.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Polyline length is a practical geometry/data-processing helper.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Boundary handling and numerically tolerant comparisons transfer to other measurements.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Bounded two-dimensional points keep the loop/type-alias lesson focused.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Strict floating comparison can incorrectly reject valid learner formulas.

defects: Strict numeric equality rejected a mathematically equivalent exp/log distance formula on the actual worker.
Destructively consuming the input passed all old checks.
Senior slice/reduce used linear intermediate storage despite a constant-state traversal being sufficient.
rationale: Retain correct reference/junior and replace senior slice/reduce with an indexed Math.hypot loop. Define finite bounded coordinates, frozen stable inputs, adjacent-only distances and exact zero for fewer than two points. Other cases use finite-number checks plus absolute1e-7/relative1e-9 tolerance, including replacement of every old strict nontrivial numeric assertion; this is task-specific, without changing the universal grader. Added checks cover irrational/fractional distances, null-prototype points,1000 frozen records and opaque metadata. The baseline exp/log alternative failed but the final version passes; input-consuming wrong fails. Target linear point count with constant working state under bounded Number math.
